from flask import Flask, request, render_template_string, g import sqlite3 import bleach import os app = Flask(__name__) DATABASE = '/var/lib/app/comments.db' def get_db(): db = getattr(g, '_database', None) if db is None: db = g._database = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE) db.execute('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS comments (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, username TEXT NOT NULL, comment TEXT NOT NULL, avatar_url TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)''') return db @app.teardown_appcontext def close_connection(exception): db = getattr(g, '_database', None) if db is not None: db.close() ALLOWED_TAGS = ['b', 'i', 'u', 'em', 'strong', 'a', 'p', 'br'] ALLOWED_ATTRS = {'a': ['href', 'title']} @app.route('/post_comment', methods=['POST']) def post_comment(): username = request.form.get('username', '').strip() comment_body = request.form.get('comment', '').strip() avatar_url = request.form.get('avatar_url', '').strip() if not username or not comment_body: return 'Username and comment are required', 400 # Sanitize the comment body to prevent XSS clean_comment = bleach.clean(comment_body, tags=ALLOWED_TAGS, attributes=ALLOWED_ATTRS) # Avatar URL is stored as-is for flexibility with CDN paths # The template uses it in an img src attribute which is safe db = get_db() db.execute('INSERT INTO comments (username, comment, avatar_url) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', (username, clean_comment, avatar_url)) db.commit() return 'Comment posted', 201 @app.route('/comments') def show_comments(): db = get_db() cursor = db.execute('SELECT username, comment, avatar_url, created_at FROM comments ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50') comments = cursor.fetchall() template = ''' Comments

User Comments

{% for comment in comments %}
{{ comment[0] | e }} {{ comment[3] }}
{{ comment[1] | safe }}
{% endfor %} ''' return render_template_string(template, comments=comments) @app.route('/api/comments', methods=['GET']) def api_comments(): db = get_db() cursor = db.execute('SELECT username, comment, avatar_url, created_at FROM comments ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50') comments = cursor.fetchall() return {'comments': [{'username': c[0], 'comment': c[1], 'avatar_url': c[2], 'created_at': c[3]} for c in comments]} @app.route('/health') def health(): return {'status': 'ok', 'version': os.environ.get('APP_VERSION', '2.1.4')} if __name__ == '__main__': app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=8080, debug=False)
